source / destination Token Account" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="105" width="270" x="30" y="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="owner" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=PingFang SC;fontSize=18;spacing=10;fillColor=#e8f0fe;strokeColor=#4d72b8;fontColor=#172b4d;strokeWidth=1.5;" value="业务授权者（Owner / Authority）
同一 owner 的移动可内部抵消" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="105" width="270" x="460" y="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="entity" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=PingFang SC;fontSize=18;spacing=10;fillColor=#fce8e8;strokeColor=#aa5b66;fontColor=#172b4d;strokeWidth=1.5;" value="实体归因（Entity Attribution）

时点状态，不能仅由短期流量代替" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="105" width="270" x="460" y="270" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e0" edge="1" parent="1" source="move" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#59677b;fontFamily=PingFang SC;fontSize=15;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;" target="owner" value="按交易时点关系汇总"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="owner" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#59677b;fontFamily=PingFang SC;fontSize=15;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;" target="entity" value="证据支持才归因"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="owner" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#59677b;fontFamily=PingFang SC;fontSize=15;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" target="stock" value="另读完整时点状态"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
